# Vacancy research: 800 Center St, Oakland

- APN: 004-0067-016-00 (user-supplied APN 004 006701600)
- Verdict: likely_vacant
- Confidence: 0.88
- Rationale: Official records describe the parcel as a vacant lot in 1997 and 2007, and the three-parcel site as vacant lots in 2021. A 2020 commercial listing and current commercial-land classification support a vacant parcel rather than an occupied building.
- Vacancy start: unknown. The 1997 letter establishes that it was already vacant by then but does not date the start.
- Duration: unknown. Vacant-lot observations in 1997 and 2021 are 24 years apart; they do not establish uninterrupted vacancy or current physical condition.

## Evidence

1. [Alameda County Environmental Health Services letter (1997-04-18)](https://dehpra.acgov.org/Lopinfo/ReadFile?record=RO0000454%5CDIR_L.pdf): calls 800 Center St a vacant lot and discusses proposed housing.
2. [Oakland City Planning Commission agenda (2007-06-06)](https://oaklandca.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/oakca1/groups/ceda/documents/webcontent/oak035590.pdf): identifies APNs 004-0067-015-00, -016-00, and -017-00 and calls the location a vacant lot; the development proposal is not proof it was built.
3. [Alameda County cleanup fact sheet (2021-09-15)](https://deh.acgov.org/landwater-assets/docs/public-notices/RO0000454_FACT_SHT_2021-09-15.pdf): says all three parcels at 800 Center Street are currently vacant lots; cleanup was scheduled for late September 2021.
4. [LoopNet listing](https://www.loopnet.com/Listing/800-Center-St-Oakland-CA/20003911/): listed the multi-parcel 800 Center site as land for sale on 2020-06-22 and names APN 004-0067-016-00.
5. [PropertyShark parcel profile](https://www.propertyshark.com/mason/Property/38495866/800-Center-St-Oakland-CA-94607/): classifies 4-67-16 as vacant commercial land and displays 2025-2026 tax data. This is secondary assessor-data aggregation.

The parcel was historically a service station site; station closure or remediation dates do not by themselves establish when the current vacant-lot condition began. The evidence supports likely vacant land, not a specific vacancy start date or continuous vacancy duration.
